name: genesis-conductor-platforms-starter-kit
description: platforms-starter-kit: Production-ready Next.js 15 multi-tenant scaffolding for Genesis Conductor ecosystem platforms by Igor Holt (@invariantx). Features custom subdomain routing via middleware, tenant-specific content/pages, shared components/layouts, Upstash Redis storage (subdomain:key pattern), admin interface, emoji branding, Vercel/Cloudflare compatibility. Built with Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui. Ideal for launching tenant-isolated Genesis Conductor services, LidLift dashboards, agent portals, and multi-org deployments. Part of the full Genesis Conductor stack (Yennefer, Diamond-V, vivarium A2A, Pareto optimization, seismic verification) with OpenClaw skills ties for agentic multi-tenant orchestration.
